query: How will we measure elicitation reliability (test–retest subset size, duplicate links), which ICC metric will we report, and what reliability threshold is acceptable?

response.query: How will we measure elicitation reliability (test–retest subset size, duplicate links), which ICC metric will we report, and what reliability threshold is acceptable?
response.answer: Elicitation reliability is measured using test-retest subset size and duplicate links. Report Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC) metric. An acceptable reliability threshold is typically ICC ≥ 0.70.
